canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. The only explicit definition treats short-term time series forecasting as predicting time series values over a short future horizon from a historical sequence. In the available usage, the description stays at the level of this prediction task formulation.

Variants. The only variant explicitly described studies the task on the M4 dataset, which the paper says includes market data across various frequencies, with prediction horizons ranging from 6 to 48. The same paper also discusses short-term forecasting alongside long-term forecasting across varying sequence lengths.

Space of elicitation and scores. No measurement instrument is linked to it. The available paper reports short-term forecasting experiments, but no separate measurement instrument is linked to the behavior.

What it is taken as evidence of. No construct is linked to it, so the available relationships do not specify what it is taken to indicate.

AutoTimes: Autoregressive Time Series Forecasters via Large Language Models
